d: "An action-packed compilation brings the Gator Boys face-to-face with some of Florida's biggest and most unpredictable reptiles. From enormous alligators lurking in ponds and backyards to unexpected snake encounters, these rescue missions put every bit of their skill and courage to the test. Alligator trappers Paul Bedard, Jimmy Riffle and Ashley Lawrence take on nuisance alligators across Florida and Mississippi, where no capture is ever quite the same.
